list: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list, 55 trophies; names, descriptions and grades as published, with this guide's own fields added

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.note: Pops on its own once the other 54 are in.
trophies.guide: The platinum is automatic: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, with no extra task of its own. Work the rest of this list in an order that suits your sessions, and treat the two golds — the final mission and 100% completion — as the long poles of the whole run.
steps: Save the two golds for the end of the plan
Let the platinum pop on its own
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PowerPyx trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.note: The opening mission — your first trophy.
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this unlocks simply by starting the story and playing it through to the end. Nothing in it can be failed permanently: if a section goes wrong, the game reloads a checkpoint and you carry on.
steps: Play Gone Fishing to the end
Let the trophy pop at the mission wrap-up
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PSNProfiles trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.note: Finish every Chapter 1 mission.
trophies.guide: Play the story through to the end of Chapter 1 and the trophy pops as the chapter closes. The official description names no optional extras, so story progression alone carries it — side content can safely wait until the map opens up.
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PlayStationTrophies.org trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.note: Finish every Chapter 2 mission.
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 of the story. Chapter trophies like this one are pure progression — the description asks for the chapter, not for medals or optional objectives — so keep following the mission chain and bank any side content you pass along the way for the counters.
steps: Bank side content for later counters
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: TrueTrophies trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.note: Finish every Chapter 3 mission.
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 of the story. By this point the state of Leonida should be opening up, so it is worth interleaving the chapter missions with exploration — the areas you uncover now feed the exploration and discovery counters later.
steps: Explore new areas as they open
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: GTA Wiki (Fandom) (named source)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.note: Finish every Chapter 4 mission.
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 of the story. This is the last full chapter trophy before the endgame, so before pushing into the finale it is a good moment to sweep up stranger strands and activity trophies while every district is open to you.
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: Push Square trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.note: The story finale — gold.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. The description does not say whether the ending branches, so keep a manual save before the point of no return if the game offers one, then play the finale through to the credits before mopping up free-roam counters.
steps: Play it through to the credits
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PowerPyx trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.note: Finish the mission Breakfast Run.
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a named story mission: play it when it appears on the map and finish it. Named-mission trophies like this one pop on completion, so the description requires no medal, no optional objective and no particular approach.
steps: Pick up the Breakfast Run mission
Play it to the final objective
Finish and let the trophy pop
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PSNProfiles trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.note: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a set-piece story mission, the closest thing on this list to a classic heist. The description only asks for completion, so take whichever approach the game offers, finish every stage of the job, and the trophy lands at the payout.
steps: Start The Cartel Heist when it is offered
Complete every stage of the job
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PlayStationTrophies.org trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.note: Finish the mission Child's Play.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies it is awarded for finishing the mission itself, so follow its objectives through and do not worry about optional side goals the description never mentions.
steps: Pick up the Child's Play mission
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: TrueTrophies trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.note: Finish the mission Headliners.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It is one of the mid-story named missions, and the trophy is for completion only — play it when the story offers it and see it through to the end.
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: GTA Wiki (Fandom) (named source)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.note: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around the VCIA airfield. While you are there, keep the separate VCIA trophy in mind — Catch Me If You Can asks for an unscheduled departure from the same place, and this mission may be the natural moment for it.
steps: Pick up the VCIA Takedown mission
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: Push Square trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.note: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The name suggests a loud, military-style set piece, but the trophy still only asks for completion — bring your best gear, work the objectives, and finish the operation.
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PowerPyx trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.note: The game's own 100% counter — it overlaps almost everything else here.
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion on the game's own counter. Almost everything else on this list feeds it — story, activities, collectibles and counters — so work the list first and use the in-game percentage to hunt what is left. The description does not publish the checklist, so the exact final items are the game's to reveal; the estimate here covers the long tail beyond the individually listed trophies.
steps: Clear the story and stranger strands
Use the in-game percentage to find the last items
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PSNProfiles trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.note: 250 stunts — clear them district by district.
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — the stunt jumps and set-piece leaps scattered around Leonida. They are repeatable free-roam content, so the efficient route is to clear them district by district whenever you pass one rather than in a single long grind. Keep a fast, durable car as your stunt vehicle so a failed landing costs a respray, not a trip across the map. The description gives the total but not the locations, so mark them off as the game reveals them.
steps: Log every completed stunt on the counter
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PlayStationTrophies.org trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.note: Sample all 9 activity types once each.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — the count behind this trophy is nine activity types. Sample one of everything the map offers (a race, a range challenge, a fishing challenge and so on) and the trophy pops when the last new type is tried, which makes it the natural first-evening trophy of the run.
steps: Open the map and list the activity types
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: TrueTrophies trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.note: Gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn one range at a time: gold is a score target, so repeat a challenge until its medal sticks before moving on, and expect the later ranges to demand several clean runs. On a stubborn range, watch one full attempt just to learn the target order before shooting in earnest — most gold scores are lost to surprises, not aim. The description fixes the count at 42 and the medal at gold — nothing less banks progress.
steps: Gold one range before moving on
Repeat challenges until the medal sticks
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: GTA Wiki (Fandom) (named source)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.note: Win a drone race at all 14 locations.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 locations in all. A win, not a medal, is the bar: learn each course with a sighting lap, then race it flat out. The description counts locations, so one win per course is enough and there is no need to farm a favourite track.
steps: Take a sighting lap at each course
Win the race at that location
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: Push Square trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.note: Win 20 different races — repeats do not count.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeats of the same race do not add to the count, so keep moving to fresh events on the map and bank one win in each; pick the shortest races first to build the total quickly, and leave the long ones for when your garage is stronger.
steps: Pick the shortest fresh race on the map
Win it and log the win
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PowerPyx trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.note: Beat Cal at his own fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find the challenge, take Cal on, and land the better catch under its rules. The description names the opponent but not the spot, so treat the first attempt as a sighting run if the challenge allows retries.
steps: Land the better catch and win
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PSNProfiles trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.note: Finish one arcade game, start to finish.
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish. Any cabinet counts by the description, so pick the shortest game you find in Leonida's arcades and bars and play it all the way through rather than walking away at the first game over.
steps: Start the shortest game on offer
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PlayStationTrophies.org trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.note: Finish Andy's stranger strand.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy — the last job in his stranger strand. Work his markers whenever they appear: strands chain several missions together, so the trophy lands only at the strand's end, not on the first job you do for him.
steps: Work the strand as new jobs appear
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: TrueTrophies trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.note: Finish Kenton's stranger strand.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton, the last job in his stranger strand. The title hints the strand ends on the water, but whatever the finale involves, the trophy is for finishing his chain of missions rather than any single job along the way.
steps: Work the strand as new jobs appear
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: GTA Wiki (Fandom) (named source)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.note: Finish Billy's stranger strand.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy, the last job in his stranger strand. Keep returning to his markers as the story opens new areas — strands often pause until you progress — and the trophy pops when his chain finally closes.
steps: Work the strand as new jobs appear
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: Push Square trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.note: Finish 8 whole stranger strands, not just first jobs.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Each strand is a chain for one character — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and others — and a strand only counts when its final mission is done, so finish chains one at a time rather than starting all of them at once.
steps: Pick one stranger strand and finish it
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PowerPyx trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.note: Finish Randy's stranger strand.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy, the last job in his stranger strand. The title suggests his chain is about moving goods, so expect driving between his markers; the trophy itself lands when the strand's final mission is complete.
steps: Work the strand as new jobs appear
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PSNProfiles trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.note: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone, the last job in his stranger strand. As with the other strand trophies, only the finale counts — keep working his markers until the chain closes and this pops alongside progress toward Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Work the strand as new jobs appear
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PlayStationTrophies.org trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.note: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots in all. These are quiet, fixed points on the map; the description gives the total but not the places, so sweep them region by region and use the counter here to keep the running total honest.
steps: Sweep one region's spots at a time
Meditate at each spot you find
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: TrueTrophies trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.note: One unique animal, hunted for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. A unique animal means one specific quarry rather than a species count: take Bret's hunt when it is offered, track the animal the way the game teaches, and make the kill clean. The description does not name the animal or the place, so be ready when the offer appears.
steps: Take the hunt when Bret offers it
Make the kill and report back
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: GTA Wiki (Fandom) (named source)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.note: Complete 3 full card sets — sets, not loose cards.
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are found one at a time around the state, and a set only counts when every card in it is held, so chase one set to completion before spreading effort across the others. When a set is down to its last card or two, finish it before opening a new district — nearly-done sets are where this trophy's hours hide. The description fixes the target at three completed sets, not at a total number of cards.
steps: Pick one card set to chase first
Collect every card in that set
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: Push Square trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.note: WAiNK It at 100 distinct locations.
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Whatever WAiNK turns out to be in the game, the pattern here is a location sweep: the description counts 100 distinct locations, so work district by district and log each one here so none is visited twice for nothing.
steps: Sweep one district at a time
WAiNK It at every marked location
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PowerPyx trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.note: 50 challenges — they surface during normal play.
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's rotating side objectives, and the description sets the total at 50 completions, so take them as they surface during normal play instead of hunting them cold — everyday sessions will bank most of the count on their own.
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PSNProfiles trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.note: Four stars, partner present, clean getaway.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape the heat together. The description needs both halves — the stars and the clean getaway — with the partner present, so pick open ground, break line of sight, and stay hidden until the search drops.
steps: Break line of sight and escape the heat
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PlayStationTrophies.org trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.note: Three shops, one unbroken wanted level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level in between. The chain is the hard part: plan three nearby shops, keep moving, and do not let the heat die between robberies or the run resets — the description counts one unbroken spree, not three separate robberies.
steps: Rob them in one run with your partner
Keep the wanted level alive throughout
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: TrueTrophies trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.note: Discover 100 distinct vehicles.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — get into each new model so the game registers it. Ordinary traffic covers most of the count over time; the rare last models are the slow part. The description counts distinct vehicles, so repeats add nothing and variety is the whole job.
steps: Swap cars whenever a new model appears
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: GTA Wiki (Fandom) (named source)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.note: Five takedowns inside one Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Set it up rather than hoping for it: start a fight with at least five enemies in view, trigger Combat Focus once, and drop five before it ends. The description allows one activation only, so positioning matters more than aim.
steps: Find a fight with five or more enemies
Line them up before triggering Combat Focus
Drop 5 enemies in the one activation
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: Push Square trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: Treat as missable until confirmed otherwise: the description ties the departure to VCIA, which the story visits for the VCIA Takedown mission — if a chance to leave unofficially appears during that visit, take it rather than assuming free roam offers another.
trophies.note: Leave VCIA the unofficial way.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave the airport the unofficial way rather than on a scheduled flight or through the front gate. The description does not spell out the method, so experiment around the airfield: an aircraft taken without clearance is the natural reading of an unscheduled departure.
steps: Find an aircraft you can take
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PowerPyx trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missableNote: Treat as missable until confirmed otherwise: Rhinos may only roll out during a particular story set-piece, so if tanks appear during a mission, deal with them there instead of counting on a free-roam spawn.
trophies.note: Rhinos are tanks — engage the first one you meet.
trophies.guide: The description — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — points at the Rhino tank: get into, or deal with, the Rhinos the game puts in front of you. It does not say whether you must steal one, survive one or destroy one, so engage the first Rhino you meet and watch for the pop.
steps: Watch for a Rhino during heavy set pieces
Stay with it until the trophy pops
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PSNProfiles trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.note: A jewelry store robbery nobody notices.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses raising the heat, and out before anyone knows. The description's bar is detection, not speed, so a slow clean robbery beats a fast loud one every time.
steps: Rob it without raising any alarm
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PlayStationTrophies.org trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.note: Five vaults robbed, five escapes made.
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape — five separate vault jobs, each ending in a clean getaway. A robbery where you are caught does not count by the description's wording ('and escape'), so plan the exit route before you crack the vault, not after.
steps: Plan the escape before each vault
Rob the vault and get out
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: TrueTrophies trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.note: One armored truck, robbed and escaped.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop or open the truck, take the money, and lose the heat that follows. The description wants the robbery and the escape together, so have a fast car and a hiding route ready before you hit it.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route
Stop it and take the money
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: GTA Wiki (Fandom) (named source)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.note: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — the count behind this trophy is 52 areas. Drive or fly every district until the map has no dark corners left; the description counts areas, so crossing into a new named area is what banks progress, not time spent inside one.
steps: Work the map region by region
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: Push Square trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.note: One illegal operation robbed per gang — 9 gangs.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs in all. One operation per gang is enough by the description, so identify which gang runs a site before hitting it, and keep the tally here so you never waste a run robbing the same gang twice.
steps: Identify which gang runs an operation
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PowerPyx trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.note: A cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order the cocktail wherever drinks are served there, and take in the view. The description names both the place and the drink, which makes this one of the cheapest trophies on the whole list.
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PSNProfiles trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.note: Drive out through the showroom glass.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — take a car out through the showroom glass. The description wants the exit done by driving through the front, so pick a showroom car, aim at the windows, and do not use the door.
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PlayStationTrophies.org trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.note: Play at the Kolt & Associates' alley.
trophies.guide: Play at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and follow through — the description's wording points at bowling a game at that named alley, follow-through and all. Find the alley, play a full game rather than a single throw, and the trophy should land at the end of it.
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley
Play it through to the end
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: TrueTrophies trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: Treat as missable until confirmed otherwise: the description sounds like a one-off story moment with your partner, so if a shared event or outing is offered during the story, take part fully rather than skipping it.
trophies.note: A shared moment with your partner — exact trigger unconfirmed.
trophies.guide: The description — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — is deliberately vague: it points at a shared moment with your partner that lands with an audience. Play the story's partner scenes as they come and take part in any joint public event the game offers; the description alone does not pin down the exact trigger, so stay alert for it rather than hunting a named location.
steps: Play partner scenes as they arise
Take part in joint public events
Watch for the pop after a shared moment
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: GTA Wiki (Fandom) (named source)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.note: 500 choices made — no choice can be wrong.
trophies.guide: Make choices — the count behind this trophy runs to 500. Choices are the game's small decisions in missions and free roam, so this is a long-haul counter that fills mostly by playing everything else on the list. The description ('for better or worse') says no choice can be wrong, so never reload a save to change one for this trophy's sake.
steps: Make every choice the game offers
Never reload to change a choice
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: Push Square trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: Treat as missable until confirmed otherwise: 'second time's the charm' implies one specific attempt that can be failed and then retried — if a story moment offers a retry after a failure, take the retry in the same playthrough rather than moving on.
trophies.note: Fail once, succeed on the retry.
trophies.guide: The description — 'Second time's the charm' — means succeeding at something on the second attempt after failing it once. It does not name the event, so the practical rule is simple: when something in the story fails you once, retry it instead of reloading an older save, and let the second attempt land.
steps: Attempt the event and fail it once
Take the retry instead of reloading
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PowerPyx trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: Treat as missable until confirmed otherwise: a strange one-off sighting may be tied to a place or a story moment, so investigate odd events when the game surfaces them instead of driving past.
trophies.note: Witness something strange — an event trophy.
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the description ('What the hell just happened?') is a reaction, not an instruction, so this is an event trophy: something odd happens somewhere in Leonida and you have to be there for it. It does not name the place, so follow up anything the game flags as unusual when you come across it.
steps: Follow up anything flagged as unusual
Stay for the whole strange event
Witness it through to the end
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PSNProfiles trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.note: A melee hit from a moving vehicle.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: knock a pedestrian down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The description wants the melee hit to land while you drive past, so line up a lone pedestrian, swing as you pass, and keep the speed low enough for the hit to connect.
steps: Drive past at a low speed
Land the melee hit as you pass
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PlayStationTrophies.org trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.note: Launder $250,000 of marked bills.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from dirty work; pass them through the laundering contacts the game gives you until the total banked reaches a quarter of a million. The description counts laundered money only, so robberies alone do not move it — the bills have to go through the wash.
steps: Earn marked bills from dirty work
Pass them to your laundering contacts

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every purchase counts toward the total, so this fills naturally if you buy vehicles, clothes and property as you go. If it lags late in the run, a few expensive late-game purchases will close the gap quickly.

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 garages in all. Buy each garage as it comes on the market; the description counts ownership, so money is the only real gate, and the laundering and spending trophies on this list help fund exactly these purchases.

trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you take a vehicle, register it in the app before moving on; the description counts 10 registrations, so make it a habit from the first cars you drive rather than a mop-up job at the end of the run.
